devdoc.details: No owner and no admin. No public function's ID can be the start of a valid letter (its four bytes are not the beginning of control-free UTF-8 text), so no letter can call a function by accident; a test checks the whole ABI. `deliver` runs the `SELL` letter's sale too, with the writer as the runner, so the writer gets the tip back.

LetterTooLong(uint256,uint256).details: A plea's text is at most 280 bytes (UTF-8): about 280 Latin, 140 Cyrillic or Arabic, 93 CJK characters.

SafeCastOverflowedUintDowncast(uint8,uin.details: Value doesn't fit in an uint of `bits` size.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

StringsInsufficientHexLength(uint256,uin.details: The `value` string doesn't fit in the specified `length`.

constructor.details: Deployed by `PleaLaunch.deployLetterbox` after the launch: it reads its settings from its deployer, so it takes no constructor arguments and its creation code, committed at launch, is the same for every deployment.

returns.out: The IMD paid to the writer.

AUTO_SELL_FEE.details: The auto-sell fee: taken from a delivered sale's IMD and paid to the season's prize pot (Seasons). Only the site's auto-sell box pays it; a letter (BY_LETTER) does not. Nothing is taken when no sale happens.

FEE_CAP_BPS.details: The fee swap may spend at most the snapshot value of the IMD it buys, plus 10%.

HOOK_SALE_FEE_BPS.details: The hook's fees on a sale: 0.25% of the PLEA burned and 2% of the IMD out (PleaHook `PLEA_BURN_BPS` + `IMD_FEE_BPS`), which the gate's net output already excludes (round 7, R7-M-1).

LETTER_SHARE_BPS.details: A letter pleads 20% of the writer's PLEA (within the gate's 2.5M cap), the edge of the gate's best share band.

MAX_FEE_SHARE_BPS.details: The fees may take at most 10% of the writer's PLEA.

MAX_PLEA_BYTES.details: CabalGate's text limit, repeated so an over-long letter is refused with a clear error.

MIN_LETTER.details: A letter below this amount is refused (the fees would dwarf it).

MIN_OUT_BPS.details: Auto-sell minimum: 95% of the PLEA's value at the hook's hourly snapshot, after the hook's sale fees (`HOOK_SALE_FEE_BPS`), so the 5% is the room for a price dip and the sale's impact.

MIN_SALE_VALUE.details: A plea must be worth at least this at the snapshot (letters too), so the auto-sell fee stays near half a sale at most (a sale pays at least 92.9% of the snapshot value after the hook's 2.25% and the 5% room, so at the floor the fee is about 51% of a sale, 54% at worst) and a letter's fees stay small next to it.

OBJECTION_WINDOW.details: The Tribunal's objection window (a test checks it against `Tribunal.OBJECTION_WINDOW`).

TIP.details: Paid to whoever delivers an approved plea; refunded when no sale happens.

mintOracleFee.details: Sepolia: the oracle fee token is a separate test token anyone can mint, so the Letterbox mints the 0.5 instead of buying it. Refused on chain id 1.

devdoc.title: Letterbox — plead to the Cabal by sending a letter

appealAuto(uint256,string).notice: Appeal a denied plea with auto-sell, for its original amount.

deliver(uint256).notice: Anyone sells an approved plea inside its 7-minute window, for at least 95% of its snapshot value after the hook's 2.25% sale fees: the sale goes to the writer (less the 0.35 IMD auto-sell fee to the season's prize pot when the plea came from the site's auto-sell box, never from a letter), the points are recorded, and the caller earns the 0.25 IMD tip.

escrowOf(uint256).notice: An escrow: writer, still open, PLEA held; and the IMD its sale paid (0 if unsold).

feesFor(bool).notice: What a plea (or an appeal) by letter costs now: the IMD it buys and the most PLEA it may spend on it (snapshot value + 10%; unspent PLEA goes back).

leaderboard().notice: The running season's top 25 as text lines: rank, name, points, and the IMD prize and PLEA bonus each rank would get from the pot as it stands.

letter(string).notice: The same letter typed into a block explorer's Write Contract tab: `text` is read exactly like a letter's input data (a plea, `APPEAL <text>`, `SELL` or `NAME <name>`).

nameOwner(bytes32).notice: The wallet holding a display name (by the name's keccak256).

openOf(address).notice: The writer's open escrow (0 if none), and the number of open escrows (each holds a tip).

plead(uint256,string).notice: Plead `amount` with the site's "sell automatically" box: escrow, fees in PLEA and the tip exactly as a letter, no approvals needed.

setName(string).notice: Sets the caller's display name: 3-20 characters of a-z, 0-9 and _, unique. An empty name clears it. Reserved: cabal, admin, imd, plea, owner. A `NAME <name>` letter does the same.

settle(uint256).notice: Anyone ends an escrow that will not be sold (denied, upheld, no verdict, expired or lapsed): the PLEA and the tip go back to the writer. A lapsed approval is recorded first, since it still counts for its season.

status(address).notice: One sentence about `w`'s latest plea, readable from a block explorer.

userdoc.notice: A letter is a transaction to this contract whose input data is the plea text (UTF-8), as a wallet's data field or an explorer's message (IDM) page sends it, or the same text passed to `letter(text)` from an explorer's Write Contract tab. The writer is always the sender. The first word decides what it does:   any other text   a new plea for 20% of the writer's PLEA, sold automatically if approved;   `APPEAL <text>`  an appeal of the writer's latest denied plea, for its original amount (an                    appeal the oracle never answered may be sent again);   `SELL`           the writer sells their own approved letter plea (if no runner did yet);   `NAME <name>`    the writer's display name (3-20 characters a-z 0-9 _, unique; `setName`). Fees are paid in PLEA in the letter's own transaction: the gate sells just enough of the writer's PLEA (at most the hourly snapshot value + 10%) for the oracle fee, a 0.25 IMD runner tip and, for an appeal, the wall share. The plea's PLEA waits here in escrow. An approved plea is sold by anyone through `deliver` (for at least 95% of its snapshot value after the hook's 2.25% sale fees), who earns the tip, and the whole sale goes to the writer: a letter pays no auto-sell fee (0.5 IMD oracle fee + 0.25 IMD tip, and the tip comes back to a writer who sends `SELL`). The site's "sell automatically" box (`plead` / `appealAuto`) has the same escrow and tip, and its delivered sale pays the auto-sell fee: 0.35 IMD of the sale (never more than the sale) to the season's prize pot, the rest to the writer. Selling by hand on the site inside the 7-minute window costs nothing extra. Every other ending returns the escrow and the tip to the writer through `settle`; the fee is only ever taken from a sale. A plea worth less than 0.70 IMD at the snapshot is refused, letters included, so a fee can never eat a sale.
